# `,` — Ravel / Catenate

`,Y` makes a vector of the items. With [axes](rank.qmd#axes), `,⍤[K]Y` ravels consecutive axes and `,⍤[⍬]Y` appends a unit axis.

```apl
,2 2⍴⍳4            ⍝ 1 2 3 4
⍴,7                ⍝ ,1ₓ
⍴,⍤[2 3]2 3 4⍴⍳24  ⍝ 2ₓ 12ₓ
```

`X,Y` joins on the last axis. `X,⍤[K]Y` joins on axis `K`. Other axes agree, with scalar and adjacent-rank extension.

```apl
1 2,3 4            ⍝ 1 2 3 4
```

A fractional axis laminates. It inserts a new axis.

```apl
⍴1 2,⍤[0.5]3 4     ⍝ 2ₓ 2ₓ
```
